items.content:
Different extraction entirely — time instead of heat, so you get almost
no acid and none of the volatile aromatics. It's not a version of the
drink. It's a different drink that happens to share a bean.

People who say they don't like coffee often like cold brew, which should
have told me something years ago.

summary: Time-not-heat extraction yields a different, low-acid drink
title: cold brew isn't cold coffee
